title: Final velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The response must state or correctly calculate the final speed of the ball when it hits the ground as 5 m/s.

title: Final horizontal distance
description: Essential: The response must state or correctly calculate the horizontal distance from C to D as 1.2 m.

title: Energy conservation to B
description: Important: The solution must apply conservation of energy (or work-energy theorem) to find the speed at point B (3 m/s) after the string is cut.

title: Projectile time calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the time of flight for the projectile motion from B to the ground using the vertical motion equations.

title: Correct height for energy
description: Important: For part (1), the solution must use the correct total vertical drop from the release point A to the ground D (H - L cos60°) in the energy conservation equation.

title: Horizontal motion application
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly apply horizontal projectile motion (constant velocity) using the speed at B and the time of flight.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution maintains consistent units (meters, seconds, m/s) throughout the calculation.

title: Confusing energy reference points
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution incorrectly uses the height from B to the ground (instead of from A to D) in the energy equation for part (1).

title: Sign error in kinematics
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution makes a sign error in the vertical kinematic equations for the projectile motion (e.g., incorrect displacement direction).
